{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float, replacing non-numeric with NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN (6 rows)
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check balance between channels across key covariates
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:\n', pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (median)
print('\nMedian customer age by channel:\n', sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].median())"}
